now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time, and without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed; without any time nothing is accepted.

window_start_minutes.description: The window opens this many minutes after now.

window_end_minutes.description: The window closes this many minutes after now (exclusive). Make the window as long as the schedule interval so runs never overlap.

own_domains.description: Your organization's email domains; attendees on them (or subdomains) are internal. If absent, the domain of the attendee the calendar marks as self.

max_meetings.description: How many meetings to accept at most.

slot_count.description: Number of fixed branches. Default: max_meetings.

max_attendees.description: Events with more person attendees are dropped as too_large.

skip_title_terms.description: Events whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive) are dropped as skip_title.

include_personal_email_meetings.description: When false, meetings whose only external attendees use personal mail domains are dropped as personal_only.

query_hint.default: company overview, recent news, funding, leadership
query_hint.description: Appended to each meeting's company search query.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for start_local and labels, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Default: the event's own offset.
